verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first piloted moonshot since the end of the Apollo program 53 years ago'; R3: 'first time astronauts return to the vicinity of the moon in more than 50 years'; R5: 'first crewed mission... for the first time in over half a century'; R6: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972'; R8: 'first crewed lunar flyby in more than 50 years'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm it as the first crewed lunar mission since Apollo (1972), over 50 years prior to 2026.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to orbit the Moon since the end of the Apollo program.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'will not land on the moon or even go into lunar orbit. Instead, the plan is to loop around it'; R6: 'crewed lunar flyby mission... did not enter lunar orbit'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state it is a flyby, not an orbit of the Moon.

verifications.claim: Artemis II breaks a 53-year streak of no crewed missions to orbit the Moon.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first piloted moonshot since... 53 years ago' but 'not... lunar orbit'; R6: 'lunar flyby... did not enter lunar orbit'
verifications.reasoning: Acknowledges 53-year gap since Apollo but confirms no lunar orbit, making claim incorrect.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will feature Christina Koch as the first woman to journey beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Christina Koch... will be the first woman to journey into deep space'; R6: 'Christina Koch the first woman... to travel beyond low Earth orbit'
verifications.reasoning: Directly attributes 'first woman beyond LEO/deep space' to Koch on Artemis II.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will feature Victor Glover as the first person of color to journey beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color... to travel beyond low Earth orbit'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states Glover as first person of color beyond LEO on this mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will feature Jeremy Hansen as the first Canadian to journey beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen'; R4: 'Jeremy Hansen... will be the first non-American to journey beyond low Earth orbit'; R6: 'first Canadian astronaut ever to travel beyond near-Earth orbit'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Hansen as first Canadian beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'commander Reid Wiseman'; R2/R5/R6/R7/R8/R9: consistently list 'Reid Wiseman' as commander
verifications.reasoning: All crew lists confirm Wiseman as commander.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes the first non-American astronaut from the Canadian Space Agency to go to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen'; R4: 'first non-American... Jeremy Hansen, a member of the Canadian Space Agency'; R5/R6: Hansen from CSA, first non-US
verifications.reasoning: Hansen identified as first non-US/CSA astronaut on lunar mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a test flight for the Orion spacecraft's life support systems with humans on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first with a crew on board... check out all of (Orion's) environmental control, life support systems'; R6: 'test flight... validate the Orion spacecraft's systems'; R8: 'demonstrate life support systems for the first time with crew'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly first crewed test of Orion including life support.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will take the crew around the far side of the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'loop around it, getting an unprecedented view of the far side of the moon'; R2: 'beyond the moon’s far side'; R6: 'looping around the far side'; R7: 'fly around our natural satellite'
verifications.reasoning: Direct descriptions of trajectory around far side.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a nine-and-a-half-day mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'nine and a half days'; R2/R4/R5: '10-day'; R6: '9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes'
verifications.reasoning: R1 matches exactly; others approximate 10 days, consistent with ~9.5 days elapsed time.
